title: They Want Our Water They Want Our Power They Want Our Land T-Shirt
description:
A clean, statement tee that speaks with quiet conviction. Lightweight 100% ring-spun cotton and a classic crew cut make this shirt feel like a second skin while the bold, minimalist text delivers a clear message: boundaries, resistance, and care for the land. Wear it on neighborhood walks, at community gatherings, or when you want your stance to be seen without shouting. The simple design pairs easily with denim and sneakers, letting the words carry the mood — steady, grounded, and resolute.

Product features
- 100% ring-spun cotton lightweight fabric (4.5 oz/yd²) for year-round comfort
- Tubular knit construction with no side seams for a smooth, waste-reducing silhouette
- Ribbed crew neckline and shoulder tape for shape retention and durability
- Pearlized tear-away label and OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certification for comfort and safety
- DTG/DTF printed graphics with durable sleeve/inner neck DTF options; EU 2-year warranty

Care instructions
- Do not dryclean
- Do not bleach
- Tumble dry: low heat
- Iron, steam or dry: low heat
- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F), with similar colors

title: Wolf Howling Mountain Landscape T-Shirt | Protect What Matters Conservation Tee
description:
A lightweight, soft cotton tee that brings the wild into everyday wear. Illustrated mountains, towering pines, and a lone wolf mid-howl are framed in a subtle wreath—earthy tones and textured linework evoke early-morning hikes and long sunsets. The message below the artwork quietly calls for conservation and care, so this shirt feels like a small, wearable pledge: comfortable enough for city life, expressive enough for weekend trail days. It sits cleanly at the crew neckline and drapes in a classic fit that layers under jackets or pairs with jeans for a calm, nature-forward look.

Product features
- 100% ring-spun cotton (lightweight 153 g/m²) — soft, breathable feel
- Tubular knit without side seams for a smooth, waste-reducing silhouette
- Ribbed crew neckline with shoulder tape — retains shape and prevents stretching
- OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certified; meets safety and chemical limits
- DTG/DTF printed options for crisp chest artwork and sleeve/neck label detailing

Care instructions
- Do not dryclean
- Do not bleach
- Tumble dry: low heat
- Iron, steam or dry: low heat
- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F), with similar colors

title: YOU CAN'T DRINK DATA Foam Trucker Hat | Funny Tech Saying, Data Analyst Cap
description:
Lightweight, bold, and a little bit cheeky — this foam trucker hat speaks the language of labs, startups, and late-night debugging sessions. The front panel carries a distressed white statement that reads like a conversation starter: short, direct, and impossible to ignore. Breathable mesh keeps heads cool during long commutes or field work. The high-profile, structured silhouette holds its shape and makes the message readable from across the room. Wear it to meetups, data reviews, or weekend hackathons — it fits into the everyday rhythm of people who live and breathe numbers but still know how to laugh about them.

Product features
- One-size, adjustable snapback fits most heads
- Structured 5-panel, high-profile foam front for bold print display
- 100% polyester front with mesh back for breathability
- Pre-curved visor with 8 rows of stitching and matching undervisor
- Thicker laminated foam front with lined interior and matching sweatband

Care instructions
- Use warm water and dish soap and clean spots off your hat. It's not necessary to soak the whole item. For hard to clean spots use a soft bristled brush.

title: Ban AI Data Centers Flag | Double-Sided Protest Banner, Outdoor Garden Flag
description:
A bold, cloth flag that makes a clear stand. Clean white fabric holds a red stop-sign emblem with the message “BAN AI DATA CENTERS,” sharp and unapologetic on both sides. It hangs easily from metal grommets and moves freely in the breeze, broadcasting a focused statement whether displayed outside a home, at a rally, or hung inside as a conversation piece. The lightweight polyester lets the color pop while staying durable against stretching and regular handling. Bring a direct voice to your space — simple, visual, and built to travel with you to protests, meetups, or everyday display.

Product features
- 100% polyester construction for strength and durability
- Vibrant, crisp double-sided print for consistent visibility
- Lightweight fabric that moves easily in the breeze
- Metal grommets for secure hanging
- Bold, high-contrast design centered on both sides
